audioDescription: Silent preview: no music, voice or sound effects.
limitations: Procedural approximation of an Impressionist manner using seeded Canvas 2D curved brush dabs: about 8.9k static dabs (700 broad underpainting scumbles, 3k sky, 560 sun, 1.9k trees, 420 bank, 2.3k water), plus 1.5k reflection dabs redrawn from time, about 200 link dabs, 5 blossoms and 230 reeds. No pigment, bristle or canvas physics.

Scene-dependent background: a stationary toned slate-teal ground #53686B, a lab mix of foreground #364747 and sky #9EBCC8, replaces the earlier cream paper. All dab colours are lab mixes of the six style tokens.

BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json reports 0 matched sources and no contact sheets, so no source-frame observations were applied. STYLE.json defines no tech.preview_recipes, so the refresh demonstrates the base implementation with a dusk palette.
Static layers are rasterized once to offscreen canvases. During the 0–1.0s paint-on they are drawn per frame using per-dab thresholds.
The shimmer and reed sway fade out between 2.1 and 2.6s, so the frame is settled by 2.7s.
Text is HTML on solid #F0E9D7 plates in system Georgia, #364747 text (contrast 8.1:1).
Blender was not used. Installed pixi.js, paper and three were not needed.

scene.js holds only the deterministic Canvas 2D dab tables and render(t). The single paused GSAP timeline is built and registered inline in index.html at window.__timelines.video, and it calls render(t) on update and on hf-seek.
